payload.title: Draft text-classifier-cookbook is publicly reachable with 14 [TODO] placeholders; 14 drafts reachable by URL
payload.description:
**Problem**
The draft article https://anth.us/articles/text-classifier-cookbook/ returns 200 and contains [TODO] placeholders (14 per the audit). In total 14 draft articles are reachable by direct URL.

**Evidence**
`curl -sL https://anth.us/articles/text-classifier-cookbook/ | grep -c TODO` is nonzero (re-checked 2026-10-20).

**Fix**
Make drafts not publicly routable (return 404 until published), or finish the cookbook. Audit the other 13 draft URLs.

**How to verify**
`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://anth.us/articles/text-classifier-cookbook/` returns 404 while it is a draft.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
